# THE SECTOR BOARD · 80 SECTORS, 8 SECTIONS, ZERO DUPLICATES

*For the LMS: this is the master slate teams claim from in Session 1. Seed data for Team.sectorName options. Each section sees only its own column of ten; families 1–8 are CORE picks, families 9–10 are BUFFER (used if a team wants an alternative). One-line scope descriptions for each sector live in the "Praxel_MU_Sector_Tracker" Google Sheet and the sector-picker page; claiming happens in the tracker sheet in v0, and can move into the LMS later.*
